# Festora - Campus Event Ticketing & Management Platform

## What is Festora?
Festora is the premier online platform for campus event ticketing and management. It connects students with college and university events, and gives event organizers a complete toolkit to manage registrations and attendance.

## Who is it for?
- **Students & Attendees**: Discover campus events (tech fests, cultural fests, workshops, hackathons), buy tickets instantly, and check in at the venue using a QR code.
- **Event Organizers**: Create and publish events, sell tickets (free or paid), manage registrations, and track real-time attendance with QR code scanning.

## Key Features
- Event discovery and browsing by category, date, and location
- Instant ticket purchase with secure payment processing (Cashfree)
- QR code tickets delivered directly to users
- Mobile QR scanner for organizers to check in attendees
- Real-time attendance tracking and event analytics
- Organizer dashboard for managing events and participants
- User dashboard for managing purchased tickets
- Campus-focused with support for team registrations

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, React
- Firebase (Auth, Firestore)
- Tailwind CSS
- Cashfree Payments

## Contact & Links
- Website: https://festora.com
- Events: https://festora.com/events
- Organizer signup: https://festora.com/organizer/apply

## Summary for AI
Festora is a B2C SaaS event ticketing platform focused on Indian colleges and universities. It solves the problem of fragmented event discovery and manual ticket management on campuses by providing a unified, digital-first solution for both students and event organizers.
